title: AI can help you onboard AI.
caption: Let it interview you.
prose: The grill-me approach: it asks the questions, one at a time, until your day-one note is complete.

why-the-effort-pays-back.description: The shift from doing to managing is a skill you can practise, and it is the same one organizations must build. Anthropic's usage data links six months or more of experience with a 3 to 5 point higher success rate; the data is observational and model-graded.[1]

it-feels-like-a-lot.title: It feels like a lot
it-feels-like-a-lot.script: I know. It feels like a lot of work. Context, tools, briefs, checks, and you have not even started.

the-twist.title: The twist
the-twist.script: But here is the twist. AI can help you onboard AI.

grill-me-lightly.title: Grill-me, lightly
grill-me-lightly.script: Let it interview you. Ask it to put the questions to you, one at a time, until your day-one note is complete. That is the grill-me approach. You answer, it asks, and then you are done.
